title: Accessibility: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Scan against WCAG 2.2 AA with findings traced to their templates, fix markup at the source, and draft a statement for review. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 74 seconds: Accessibility, 3 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-wcag22-aa-agentic, typo3-accessibility, typo3-a11y). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: An accessibility report helps when every finding points to the template that causes it.
Accessibility: three skills for TYPO3 v14.
Scans with Playwright and axe-core and names the Fluid template behind each finding.
The report lists each violation by page and drafts the accessibility statement.
Accessible patterns for Fluid, PHP and JavaScript, with a checklist to verify by hand.
When a screen reader does not announce an accordion as expandable, this skill gives you the markup that fixes it.
Accessible patterns for navigation, filters, tables, sticky headers and language switchers.
It works to WCAG 2.2 AA for sitepackage frontends, with a checklist for every content element.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
